x: And when it comes bringing with it Mrs. Gordon, our President, the spirit stove, sandwiches and copious cups of tea, and we are sitting down to our alfresco breakfast amid the Sussex Downs with the skylarks for orchestra—why, we are prepared to admit that the everyday world we have just returned to…

Our profound sympathy goes to Past President Teddy Gordon on the loss of his wife—so well remembered by so many of us. We shall miss Mrs. Gordon at our meetings and functions; and recall with gratitude her many services to the Club in the past.
